title: Square flux calculation
description: Essential: Student correctly calculates Φ₁ = BL² using the area of the square.

title: Perimeter conservation
description: Important: Student states or uses that the perimeter of the square (4L) equals the circumference of the circle.

title: Circle radius derivation
description: Important: Student correctly derives the circle's radius as r = 2L/π from the conserved perimeter.

title: Circle flux calculation
description: Essential: Student correctly calculates Φ₂ = Bπr² and simplifies to 4BL²/π.

title: Flux formula application
description: Important: Student correctly applies the magnetic flux formula Φ = B⋅A for both geometries, noting field is perpendicular.

title: Unit consistency
description: Optional: Student includes or verifies correct units (T·m² or Wb) for magnetic flux.

title: Perimeter misuse
description: Pitfall: Student incorrectly assumes area is conserved instead of perimeter when finding the circle's dimensions.

title: Algebraic error
description: Pitfall: Student makes an algebraic mistake in deriving the radius or area of the circle (e.g., r = L/π, r = 4L/π).
